title: Apple stockpiles inventory as it braces for ‘significant supply constraints’

We got to spend some time with the Watch 9 and Watch 2 Ultra at Samsung’s July 2026 Unpacked event, so make sure to read our initial impressions of both watches if you’re curious about how the upgrades feel ahead of their early August launch.

title: Govee’s portable smart lamp is down to one of its best prices to date
summary: Govee's rechargeable Table Lamp Classic is available for $59 at Amazon, just $4 shy of its all-time low price. The cordless lamp offers 30 hours of battery life with colored lighting, supports smart home platforms via Matter, and provides versatile lighting for any room.
content:
Buying multiple lamps for different rooms can get expensive. Govee’s rechargeable Table Lamp Classic gives you one lamp you can use throughout your home instead of getting one for every room, and right now it’s down to $59 ($21 off) at Amazon. That’s just $4 shy of the all-time low set during Prime Day, and the smart lamp’s second-best price to date.


Govee Table Lamp Classic

Where to Buy:

 $79.99 $59.99 at Amazon
 $79.99 $63.99 at Govee

Because it’s cordless, the lamp is surprisingly versatile. You can use it to brighten your desk during the day, keep it by your bedside at night, and even carry it to the patio for dinner (just don’t forget to bring it back inside if it’s expected to rain, as the lamp isn’t weather-resistant). A built-in 4,800mAh battery powers the lamp for up to 30 hours with colored lighting enabled, or about five hours when using bright white light, so you don’t need to worry about staying near an outlet. 
Despite being small and light enough to carry from room to room, the Table Lamp Classic offers many of the same smart lighting features found on Govee’s bigger lamps. It lets you tweak the color temperature, cycle through 72 preset scenes, and sync the lighting to your music, making it easy to match the mood whether you’re studying, unwinding, or enjoying a date night. If you have something more specific in mind, Govee’s app can even generate a custom effect from a short text prompt. Since it supports Matter, you won’t have to reach for the Govee app every time you move the lamp to a different room, either. Instead, you can control it with your voice through your favorite smart home platform.

title: Pixel 11 Pro Fold design leaks ahead of Google launch event
summary: Marketing renders of the unreleased Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold have leaked, revealing a design that closely mirrors last year's model with a tall outer screen and 8-inch inner display. The renders also show a redesigned rear camera array with a glowing light feature.
content:
Weeks ahead of Google's next Pixel hardware event, Leaker Evan Blass has shared what appear to be marketing renders of the unannounced Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold in a post on his Substack.
The renders, if accurate, show that the new foldable will look fairly similar to last year's model - it has a tall outer screen instead of using a shorter style like the new Galaxy Z Fold 8 and the rumored foldable iPhone. The renders also show that the inner screen will retain the 8-inch size. However, the Pixel 11 Pro Fold's back camera array has been slightly redesigned and will apparently get the glowy light that Google has already teased for the Pixel  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Pixel 11 Pro Fold 设计在谷歌发布会前泄露
zh.summary: 未发布的谷歌 Pixel 11 Pro Fold 的营销渲染图泄露，显示其设计与去年的型号非常相似，具有高大的外屏和 8 英寸内屏。这些渲染图还展示了重新设计的后置摄像头阵列，具有发光功能。

title: Friend re-launches its AI pendant with a speaker that talks to you, for twice the price
summary: Friend AI pendant is relaunching with an added speaker feature that allows the device to talk back to users rather than just send messages, though the price has doubled. The company is returning to market after its previous venture that included a costly domain acquisition.
content:
Do you remember Friend? The Friend that launched an AI pendant, spent $1.8 million of its $2.5 million in funding to acquire friend.com, and plastered the NYC subway with ads promoting artificial companionship?
Yeah well, if you didn't remember, Friend is back. And now, it's twice the price.
This morning, Friend launched a new ad showing two people talking to their Friend pendants about very personal life problems. It didn't say it explicitly, but the ad showcased a new feature the pendant now includes: a speaker. Before, Friend would only message back to you, but now, it will talk to you, too. For some reason, the addition of that feature …
Read the full story at The Verge.

content: The deal gives Okta identity threat detection capabilities as enterprises seek to secure AI agents and other non-human identities across cloud environments.

content: The milestone means Tesla is halfway to accomplishing one of the four core product goals Elon Musk has to hit to unlock his full $1 trillion pay package.

title: Quantum computers outperform classical ones, with results you can trust
summary: Researchers demonstrated that quantum computers can outperform classical systems while producing verifiable results through classical computation. Three distinct approaches address the fundamental challenge of validating quantum outcomes without requiring another quantum computer to confirm them.
content: Three approaches to the issue of quantum results that can't be verified classically.

title: FTC sues Hims & Hers for allegedly sharing patients’ medical data with advertisers Meta and Snap
summary: The FTC has filed a lawsuit against Hims & Hers for allegedly using website trackers to share patients' medical data with advertisers Meta and Snap without proper consent, raising privacy concerns in the telehealth sector.
content: The U.S. federal consumer watchdog said Hims & Hers, which prescribes for sexual wellness and mental health conditions, used website trackers to share customers' information with advertisers.

title: Zoox clears final federal hurdle to launch paid robotaxi service

An easier way to find the right beats for your BPM. | Image: Spotify	

Spotify has introduced a new Running Mode feature that makes it easier to curate playlists around your workout goals, music tastes, and desired beats per minute (BPM). The aim is to help you "spend less time hunting for the right music and more time moving," according to Spotify's announcement, providing customizable running presets and optional coaching features.
Running Mode is an AI-powered experience that builds on personalization capabilities that were introduced with Prompted Playlists last year, with Spotify finding that fitness-based prompts have been some of the most popular uses for that feature. It requires a Premium subscription …

title: Amazon’s short story collections are one of the best reasons to own a Kindle
summary: Amazon's curated short story collections on Kindle provide compelling value for e-reader owners, offering accessibility and convenience that competes with the satisfaction of physical book collecting.
content:
Over the last few years, I've gradually shifted away from ebooks. It's been part of a general return to physical media, an attempt to create a deeper sense of ownership over the art I love and collect. A Kindle is obviously more convenient than a paperback: It's tiny, holds a huge library, and you can purchase new books instantly. But, much like with retro game cartridges, I find there's a deeper connection formed with a book dug out of a stack in a used book shop versus simply choosing the next thing in a series from a menu on an e-reader. But I haven't completely given up on my Kindle, and there's one big reason - actually, there are lots  …

title: A second lens makes DJI’s Osmo Pocket 4P my new favorite video camera
summary: DJI's Osmo Pocket 4P adds a 3x telephoto lens to the Osmo Pocket 4, offering improved video capabilities at a competitive price compared to rival Insta360's Luna Ultra, making it an excellent choice for most prospective buyers.
content:
Like other recent DJI products, the Pocket 4P won’t launch in the US.	

DJI's Osmo Pocket 4P is a pretty simple proposition: an Osmo Pocket 4 with a second camera lens slapped inside. But is that extra lens worth the added size, weight, and cost relative to the regular Pocket 4? And how does it compare to the only rival on the market, Insta360's dual-lens Luna Ultra? 
It depends on what you're filming. But I think most prospective buyers would get plenty of use out of the 4P's 3x telephoto lens, and its quality is certainly impressive. Meanwhile, DJI has managed to undercut Insta360 on price while at least matching it on quality. For most, this will be the better buy, though the Luna Ultra has one major advanta …

title: SwitchBot makes a better fan
summary: SwitchBot's new Battery Circulator Fan 2 Pro is a portable, battery-powered smart fan featuring extended runtime, increased airflow, native Matter support, and quiet operation, priced at $119.99 for mid-sized rooms and outdoor use.
content:
SwitchBot Battery Circulator Fan 2 Pro is smart, powerful, and portable. | Image: SwitchBot	

I was already a big fan of SwitchBot's big circulator fan I recently reviewed, and now we're getting the SwitchBot Battery Circulator Fan 2 Pro.
